issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type String, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. The problem text instructs students to check the UML for the expected return type, which would lead them to implement a String-returning method that conflicts with the reference implementation and likely with tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Preferably update the UML and problem statement to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and update any explanatory text/examples accordingly), or alternatively change the solution implementation to return String. Ensure tests and examples reflect the chosen type so students know which type to implement.
